source_note: This follow-up keeps the discrete target-template local attractor but repeatedly applies seeded stochastic dropout damage before repair. It is not a trained regenerating NCA.

decision.reason: The assisted local-attractor baseline survives repeated seeded dropout repair cycles, so repeated stochastic damage is now part of the CA/NCA benchmark contract.

limitations: The repair rule still receives the target grid as a template.
Stochastic damage is seeded dropout, not a learned damage curriculum.
The benchmark does not include human visual repair ratings.
A trained NCA would need to beat this assisted baseline.
